about: ONS International Passenger Survey, table 4.03 (long-term international migration by country of birth and country of last or next residence), inflow of all birth countries with Poland as the country of last residence, in people. ci95 is the published 95% confidence interval. Used only to fill years that Eurostat lacks for the UK (2007, 2019). Source: https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/internationalmigration/datasets/ipscountryofbirthbycountryoflastornextresidence
